title: MoodFaceDef
description:
A mood_face definition from JSON type `"mood_face"`.

Defines a set of mood faces for the player character, with different faces shown at different morale values.

abstract_.description: Abstract flag — if true, this definition is a template that should not be instantiated directly.

copy_from.description: Base definition id to copy fields from.

MoodFaceValue.description: A single mood face entry mapping a morale value threshold to a face string.

face.description: Face string (may include color markup like `<color_green>:)</color>`).
